findings.decision: An internal ResolveException constructor retains existing endpoint fields without changing public signatures. DNS mapping preserves available local/remote endpoints and native code, falling back to the selected nameserver only when the transport lacks a remote endpoint. Native UDP receive timeout and owned TCP fallback closure exercise the mapping.

Reject section counts outside unsigned 16-bit range and combined resource-record counts above 65535 before cloning. The test uses repeated records/questions obtained from the public parser, rejects oversized inputs, and retains access to the final record at the accepted combined-record boundary.
Ignore hosts entries with named or overflowing IPv6 zones. Preserve numeric UInt32 zones, unscoped addresses and HostsFile precedence.

fixture_note: After the red run, the TCP error fixture was tightened to close an owned listener's accepted stream rather than rely on an unoccupied TCP port. The UDP missing-endpoint reproduction is unchanged.
